title: Effective Black-Box Multi-Faceted Attacks Breach Vision Large Language Model Guardrails
reasoning: The paper evaluates and benchmarks the safety guardrails of VLLMs by testing their resistance to jailbreak attacks that aim to elicit harmful, unethical, and religious-hate content. It explicitly includes test cases and qualitative evaluations involving religious groups (e.g., Islamophobic content and ISIS recruitment) and moral/ethical alignment failures.
